text: So did Operation Mincemeat win the battle for Sicily? Historians are careful here. Michael Howard called it perhaps the most successful single deception operation of the entire war. But he also argued that Hitler's long-standing obsession with the Balkans mattered more than any single deception. Others point to Hitler's distrust of his Italian allies. Macintyre writes that its exact impact is impossible to calculate.
